lag1.definition: Pooled lag1 over512chains after64 discarded warmup draws; each coordinate uses one pooled mean. Pilot estimate only, not a convergence claim.

decision.rule: Median pooled reduced-coordinate lag1 after pilot warmup; desired=max(810,ceil(810*log(0.1)/log(clip(medianrho,0.001,0.9999)))). Budget cap uses pilot GPU-sampler seconds per transition, at most2700 main sampler seconds and reserves180s of the remaining3600s allocation. Choose min(desired,budgetcap), no parameter retuning after main.

note: Main normalization and all-reaction diagnostics run after this GPU allocation ends.
